basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate with a degree in business management, living in Austin, Texas. I’ve recently developed an interest in crowdfunding and have just completed my first Kickstarter campaign. I enjoy learning about new management techniques and often end up browsing Reddit in the evenings after work. Currently working as a junior project manager at a tech startup. I’m single and enjoy spending my weekends watching movies or working on my car, a Honda Prelude.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a formal education in business management, which has given me a solid foundation in project planning and execution. I’m also self-taught in areas like crowdfunding, learning from online resources and personal experimentation.
